subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Three Classes of Levers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Three Classes of Levers usable.

hook.text: A wheelbarrow, a nutcracker, and a pair of tweezers are all levers — but different kinds.

buildup.text: Class one puts the fulcrum between effort and load — like a seesaw or crowbar.

discovery.text: Class two puts the load between fulcrum and effort. A wheelbarrow lifts heavy loads easily.

twist.text: Class three puts effort in the middle. Tweezers and fishing rods sacrifice force for speed.

climax.text: Your forearm is a class three lever. The bicep pulls near the elbow to swing the hand fast.

punchline.text: Your body runs on levers. You just never noticed.

quiz.question: Which class of lever does a wheelbarrow represent?
options: Class one — fulcrum is between effort and load
Class two — load is between fulcrum and effort
Class three — effort is between fulcrum and load
